en: Colorized postcard view of a riverside town with a large historic castle complex and Gothic cathedral on a hill. A long white paddle steamer named "WETTIN" is in the foreground on the river. The castle with round tower and the twin-spired church dominate the skyline. Red-roofed houses line the riverbank. The words "Meissen" appear at the upper left, and "Kgl. Albrechtsburg u. Dom." at the upper right, with a red handwritten number in the top right corner.
